verdict.rationale: Recurly offers a full REST API and official client libraries (Ruby, Node, Python, .NET, Java, PHP, Go) which could be scripted headlessly in CI, but there is no explicit documentation of a CLI, CI/CD examples, or automation-focused tooling for headless/agentic workflows. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage examples, a documented CLI tool, evidence of non-interactive/automation-first design beyond generic API/SDK availability.
